newsitem.title: USA: Donohue Inc unit sets $200 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Donohue Inc unit sets $200 mln in debt.

text.p: The following $200 million debt issue from Donohue Inc unit Donohue Forest Products Inc, was priced on Tuesday via Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities, dealers said.
Proceeds from the offering, guaranteed by the parent firm, will be used to repay indebtedness, fund capital expenditures and for other general corporate purposes, the company said.
Donohue is a major Canadian integrated producer of newsprint, market pulp and lumber and is headquartered in Quebec City, Quebec.
